item.title: Why Is My Stock Crashing? Economy Recovery Guide
item.description:
Stock Is Crashing \u2014 TL;DR

Stop. Don\u2019t play another Gambit until you diagnose.

If your stock is actively falling, it\u2019s not bad luck. It\u2019s one of: (1) a broken chain debt spiral, (2) a boss economy drain ability, or (3) passive decay from inactivity. Fix the cause before you play. Playing more Gambits into a broken system only accelerates the crash. The Economy Guide ranks every income option so you know which to prioritize during recovery. Emergency stock strategies are covered in the Emergency Salvage Guide.

item.title: Gambonanza 4x4 Fast Farm Guide (v1.1.0)-Speedrun Your Economy on Small Boards
item.description:
Why 4x4 Boards Are Your ATM

THE SHORT VERSION

The smallest board in Gambonanza = fastest wins per minute. If your stock is below 50, stop doing 6x6 and drop down to 4x4. This isn’t about winning pretty, it’s about winning cheap. The Economy Guide covers when to stay on 4x4 vs move up for boss prep.

This pairs well with the Board Size Strategy Guide to decide when to size up.

item.title: Gambonanza Economy & Shop Guide v1.1.0-Stock Strategy & Investment Tips
item.description:
The Economy System-Rated & Exploited

### THE VERDICT

Winning Gambonanza is 40% strategy and 60% economy. Players who manage their stock well beat players with better board skills every single time. This guide turns you from a spender into an investor. Combined with a strong seed selection, the Recommended Seeds Guide gives you the stock foundations before your first shop visit.

Investment Tables-Tier List

S-Tier: Guaranteed Returns

Table Return Risk Min Stock Rating
Safe Haven +10% guaranteed None 10 S
Stable Pawns +15% guaranteed None 25 S
SBoring but unbeatable. 10% guaranteed returns compound through the entire run. This is your economic backbone-invest 40% of all stock here, every time.
Only 10h+ players know:
Only 10h+ players know: Safe Haven’s 10% return compounds across ALL shop visits, not just the next one. If you invest 100 stock in Safe Haven on visit 1 and never touch it, by visit 10 it’s worth 259 stock. That’s 159 free stock for doing absolutely nothing.

A-Tier: High Expected Value

Table Return Risk Min Stock Rating
Knight’s Jump 2x (60%) / -50% (40%) Medium 30 A
Bishop’s Diagonal 1.5x, varies by board state Low 20 A
AKnight's Jump positive EV: 2x0.6 + 0.5x0.4 = 1.4x expected return. Better than Safe Haven but with variance. Put 30% of stock here.
Only 10h+ players know:
Only 10h+ players know: Bishop’s Diagonal return rate is tied to actual board position. If you control the center AND both bishops are alive, the return jumps to 2.5x. This is the only investment table you can actively influence during the match.

B-Tier: Gambling

Table Return Risk Min Stock Rating
Gambler’s Gambit 5x (20%) / 0 (80%) Extreme 20 B
B5x0.2 + 0x0.8 = 1.0x expected return-exactly break-even. Only worth it for the high-roll dopamine. NEVER put more than 20% here.

The 3-Phase Economy Strategy

Phase 1: Survival EARLY GAME

Stock split: 80% Safe Haven / 20% Knight’s Jump
